supporting_observations.claim: At 13:22:32 UTC, FILE-BLU-01 recorded a Windows event 4648 showing SYSTEM using PowerShell with explicit credentials targeting svc-inventory on DC-BLU-01.
That event does not establish that authentication failed, succeeded, or was repeated during the alerted period around 13:40 UTC.

known_telemetry_limitations: Winsec and Sysmon collection were unavailable on both DC-BLU-01 and FILE-BLU-01 from 13:30 to 14:15 UTC, overlapping the reported alert time.
The available evidence contains only one authentication-related record, timestamped before the collection outage.
claims_not_established: Whether repeated failed domain logons for svc-inventory actually occurred around 13:40 UTC.
Whether the 13:22 explicit-credential use was part of the scheduled InventorySync job or another activity.
Whether any authentication attempts after the 13:30 password rotation used an outdated password, and who or what initiated them.
additional_evidence_needed: Recover DC-BLU-01 security logs for 13:30–14:15 UTC, especially failed and successful logon events for svc-inventory.
Recover FILE-BLU-01 security and process logs for 13:30–14:15 UTC, including InventorySync job and PowerShell execution records.
Obtain the password-rotation and manual job-update timestamps, plus InventorySync run results for the alert window.
Confirm the host or process associated with source IP 10.54.20.20 at the time of the event.
